thread.title: Technology Sector Update for 01/31/2019: FLEX, FB, IIVI, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG

author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 01/31/2019: FLEX, FB, IIVI, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: -2.71%
AAPL: +0.64%
IBM: +0.08%
CSCO: +0.51%
GOOG: +1.22%
Most technology stocks were gaining in Thursday's pre-bell trading.
Early movers include:
(+) Flextronics International ( FLEX ), which was up more than 11% as its adjusted EPS rose to $0.34 in Q3 from $0.31 a year earlier, beating analysts' estimates of $0.30 in a Capital IQ poll.
(+) Facebook ( FB ) was 10% higher after its reported better-than-expected results for its fourth quarter, which were bolstered by double-digit growth in advertising revenue.
(+) II-VI ( IIVI ) was gaining more than 11% in value after booking fiscal Q2 adjusted earnings of $0.71 per share, which is a 34% increase from $0.53 per share in the comparable period a year ago. The result also topped the Street estimate of $0.67 per share.
